label: Rock in Rio 2026 — 06/09 (dom) · Gramado
_note_supply: Officially sold out at the box office when observed 2026-09-01; the resale market was NOT empty -- 228 Gramado Inteira listed, cheapest Gramado R$ 440,00.
_note_face_value: Gramado face value (Juan, 2026-09-01): Inteira R$ 870,00 / Meia R$ 435,00. Because the gate does not check class, R$ 435,00 is the effective benchmark for the cheapest usable ticket -- anything above it is a resale premium. Documentation only: no rule reads this field.
_note_filters: Gramado only (Juan's call 2026-09-01). entry_class is deliberately unfiltered: Rock in Rio does not check ticket type at the gate, so any class is usable and the cheapest one wins. Set extra.sector to null to watch all 6 sectors.
_note_rules: ONLY lowest_ever is enabled. lowest_in_window is configured but DISABLED here: these are tracking nights, not nights Juan would buy, so an expiring-baseline rule would add alerts he cannot act on. Flip `enabled` to arm it.
